notablePrerequisites:
(THE PEREGRINE DYNAMO'S TARGET) is not your commander.
An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Holding priority, activate Abstruse Archaic by paying {1} and tapping it, copying The Peregrine Dynamo's trigger, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Resolve both Peregrine Dynamo triggers, copying Etrata's trigger twice.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.
